attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Beyond the flaky-test fix, this changes production semantics (e.g., AzureAISearchIndexManager.CreateAsync now returns false for an already-existing index instead of true, and Elasticsearch's create/get methods gain new early-return false/null paths) and substantially reworks Lucene's writer/reader locking (removing IsClosing writer cleanup, merging the directory-open lock into the general _lock), which are concurrency-sensitive changes that are easy to get subtly wrong and hard to validate via automated tests alone."}
